thread:
Priya: Can we build a micro "goal-setting" cheat sheet for quick 15-min check-ins? Need manager and IC phrasing, copy/paste ready, and a tiny escalation signal.

Alyssa: Yep. I'll sketch a super-compact set of prompts. Proposal: 5 mini-cards (Start, Focus, Blockers, Win, Next) + IC variants.

Devon: First draft here. Short lines only so folks can paste into 1:1 notes. Feedback welcome.

Devon: ```Start (30s): "One-sentence goal this quarter? What does success look like?"
Example: "Improve search relevance so weekly active users stick 5% longer."

Focus (4 min): "What's the single priority this sprint toward that goal? Any changes since last check?"
Example: "Ship weighted ranking change v1.0; alpha metrics in staging by Thursday."

Blockers (3 min): "Any blockers or dependencies? If so, what's the lift needed to clear them?"
Example: "Need infra approval for extra shard; ask EngLead to prioritize review."

Win (1 min): "One thing you did well since last time that moved the needle?"
Example: "Wrote migration script that cut rollout time by half."

Next (1.5 min): "What's the one thing you'll do before our next check to make progress? Any help?"
Example: "Prototype ranking tweak and run 100 users; need a QA pass."

Escalation signal (15s): "Flag with :warning: if this blocks other teams or is >2 weeks risk. Loop EngLead for cross-team, PeopleOps for career/comp concerns."
```

Priya: Great. Can we also add IC phrasing that removes manager prompts and is direct to the contributor?

Jordan: Here's an IC-friendly edit: replace manager questions with "Action: ..." statements and a one-line 'ask' for support. Also add emoji keys for quick notes: :white_check_mark: on-track, :warning: risk, :rocket: stretch.

Maria: Suggest a 15s "no-surprises" script for async updates managers can post in thread: "Status: :white_check_mark: / :warning: ; Next: <one-liner> ; Blockers: <one-liner>". Keeps standups tiny.

Devon: Updated with IC language and the async template. Also added timing header: Start (30s) / Core (10min) / Wrap (4.5min).

Devon: ```IC Async template (15s): "Status: :white_check_mark: ; Next: finish prototype; Blockers: need infra review by Fri."

Manager 15s no-surprises: "Quick check: Status :warning: (blocked); Blocker: infra approval; Action: EngLead review request."
```

Priya: Perfect. Two tiny polish items: 1) call out who to cc for escalation (EngLead, PeopleOps) 2) add a sample 2-line praise template managers can paste.

Alyssa: Paste-ready praise: "Thanks for leading X — your play (brief) saved time/money/ambiguity. Can you share the steps so team can reuse?"

Devon: Final note: uploaded to handbook and dropped a short card in Notion under Manager Toolkit. PeopleOps Bot: confirmed copy to /handbook/manager-toolkit/micro-goal-checks.md :link:

Alyssa: I'll format the IC + Manager cards in Notion and tag leads. Thanks everyone! :sparkles:
